newsitem.title: USA: F&M Bancorp, Citizens Nat'l to affiliate.
newsitem.headline: F&M Bancorp, Citizens Nat'l to affiliate.

text.p: F&M Bancorp Inc said Thursday it executed a definitive agreement under which it would affiliate with Citizens National Bank of Darlington.
Shareholders of Citizens National Bank would receive F&M stock as part of the definitive pact. Specific terms were not disclosed.
Citizens National, with assets of about $75 million and locations in Darlington and Hazel Green, Wis., is a wholly owned subsidiary of Citizens National Bancorp Inc.
F&M has assets of more than $1.3 billion.
